short_bio: Film director of Taxi Driver, Raging Bull, Goodfellas and The Departed.
biography:
Martin Scorsese grew up in New York’s Little Italy and studied film at New York University. Mean Streets (1973) marked him out, and Taxi Driver (1976) won the Palme d’Or at Cannes.

Raging Bull (1980) and Goodfellas (1990) are regularly ranked among the great American films. He won Best Director and Best Picture for The Departed (2006).

Later work includes Hugo (2011), The Wolf of Wall Street (2013), Silence (2016), The Irishman (2019) and Killers of the Flower Moon (2023). In 1990 he founded The Film Foundation to preserve older films.
